The Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) is offering spot crude in a tender, its eighth issued since the start of June as the UAE state oil company works to move oil from inside the Strait of Hormuz, trade sources said.

ADNOC on Monday offered Upper Zakum, Umm Lulu and Das crude for loading in October and November. Bids are due by August 13 and will remain valid until August 14.

Shrinking regional oil stockpiles held by #China’s independent refiners in Shandong province may spur increased buying of Iranian crude.
Inventories in Shandong dropped to 360 million barrels in July, the lowest level in eight months, according to data compiled by Energy Aspects.
Energy Aspects estimates stockpiles in Shandong declined by 35 million barrels last month, the biggest monthly draw since the consultant started compiling the figures in 2016.
Shrinking regional oil stockpiles held by China’s independent refiners in Shandong province may spur increased buying of Iranian crude, offering Tehran a needed boost after a period of slow sales.

Inventories in Shandong — home to most of China’s so-called teapot refiners — dropped to 360 million barrels in July, the lowest level in eight months, according to data compiled by Energy Aspects. Stockpiles in the region are held by both private as well as state-run processors.

China’s teapots dialed back purchases and relied heavily on stockpiles after Beijing instructed them to maximize fuel production to help cushion the impact of the Iran war. The refiners are by far the biggest buyers of Iranian crude, typically accounting for about 90% of sales, and softening demand led to a swelling hoard of the country’s oil on tankers at sea.

A drone attack on an oil refinery in western #Libya destroyed a storage tank, putting oil facilities at risk and potentially aggravating fuel shortages in the OPEC nation.

The attack on Zawiya refinery started a fire before the fuel tank collapsed due to high temperatures, National Oil Corp. Chairman Masoud Suleman said in an interview. Authorities sought to extinguish the flames and cool other tanks to prevent them from being set ablaze, he added.

NOC later said another drone targeted an oil blending and packaging plant affiliated with Zawiya refinery.

#Agriculture: Global food prices rose to a three-year high last month as summer heatwaves and conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East lifted crop costs, potentially feeding through to higher consumer prices in the coming months. The UN FAO Food Price Index reached its highest since January 2023, although the year-on-year increase remained contained at just 1%. Sugar led the monthly rise at 5.6%, followed by grains at 3.4% and vegetable oils at 2%, while meat fell 2.8% and dairy declined 0.7%.
